summary: Sporting News' Nick Brinkerhoff lays out his FanDuel DFS GPP lineup for the Week 14 Sunday main slate of the 2023 NFL season, with a $60,000 budget, plus a SuperDraft lineup. Each pick comes with a salary and matchup rationale, such as the Minshew-Pittman stack against a Bengals team without Joe Burrow. The piece also explains FanDuel and SuperDraft scoring rules.
one_line: Nick Brinkerhoff's Week 14 2023 NFL FanDuel GPP lineup and SuperDraft picks, with salaries, matchups and scoring rules.
key_facts: FanDuel scoring rules highlighted: four-point passing TDs and half-point PPR; the Sunday main slate budget is $60,000.
QB Gardner Minshew (Colts @ Bengals, $6,900): the Colts are 7-5, and Minshew had 312 yards and two TDs the previous week.
The Bengals are limping because Joe Burrow's thumb injury cost him the season; Jake Browning is now their QB.
RB Joe Mixon (Bengals vs. Colts, $7,200) scored two touchdowns on Monday night against the Jaguars, and the Colts were torched by Derrick Henry and Tyjae Spears a week earlier.
RB Breece Hall (Jets vs. Texans, $6,400) is chosen for his carries and passing-game role despite the Jets offense's inability to score.
WR Mike Evans (Buccaneers @ Falcons, $8,500) had six catches on eight targets for 82 yards and a score the last time he faced the Falcons; Baker Mayfield is his QB.
WR Michael Pittman Jr. (Colts @ Bengals, $8,000) has back-to-back 100-yard games and a season-high 16 targets against the Titans.
WR Deebo Samuel (49ers vs. Seahawks, $7,500) has historically feasted against Seattle and carved them up on Thanksgiving.
TE Gerald Everett (Chargers @ Broncos, $5,100) has not posted 50 yards in a game this season but has a great matchup.
FLEX RB Dameon Pierce (Texans @ Jets, $6,100) had 15 carries last week to Devin Singletary's eight, in expected rainy weather at MetLife Stadium.
DEF New Orleans Saints (vs. Panthers, $4,300): the Panthers are 1-11 and the Saints are 5-7 but still in the playoff race.
SuperDraft uses point multipliers rather than salary caps, with two-point bonuses for 100 rushing yards, 100 receiving yards and 300 passing yards.
SuperDraft lineup: Justin Fields (1.2x), Christian McCaffrey (1x), Joe Mixon (1.3x), DJ Moore (1.25x), Michael Pittman Jr. (1.2x), Mike Evans (1.1x), Gerald Everett (1.6x), flex Alvin Kamara (1.1x).
